saw_lines: Skate shoes get bought on fit and grip, then replaced when the sole wears through, so the same buyer comes back.
So the sale is won or lost at the first pair, when a new buyer needs a reason to trust you.
Your site offers a 30 Day Guarantee, yet 0 of 20 copy ads mention it. Open three new ads with the guarantee in line one and print it on the creative.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 4 Nov 2026
points: Your site offers a 30 Day Guarantee, yet 0 of 20 copy ads mention it, so a first time buyer has no reason to act. Open three new ads with the guarantee in line one and print it on the creative.
None of your 30 live ads carries a proof number, so buyers have nothing concrete before they click. Pick one real figure, like a review count or orders shipped, and open three new ads with it.

Your 20 copy ads open 13 different ways, and the biggest, the 1994 Globe story, leads only 2 ads. Buyers never hear one message enough to remember it. Pick the two strongest stories and build three ads from each.

30 of your ads have run 60 days or more, so the account already has proven winners. Build three more variations of the Tilt ad, each with a new first line, and put the 30 Day Guarantee on each creative.

ads_1: Guarantee-led openers for Tilt and Encore-2, built from the two strongest stories
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram and YouTube
